rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both are presidential letters assigning the Bureau of the Budget leadership over a cross-agency initiative, directing cooperation with affected departments and agencies, requiring development of plans, and requesting recommendations for matters needing further action. C09 is also a strong structural analogue for an orderly governmental transition, while C14 parallels the study–comprehensive plan–recommendations sequence. C06 is strongest because it combines that machinery with the same lead agency and closely similar directive language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I believe that the Bureau of the Budget should assume leadership for Executive Branch action in this area
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I believe the Bureau is the logical agency to assume leadership in such activities.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared formulation assigning leadership to the Bureau of the Budget.

shared_material.child_excerpt: with the cooperation of the interested departments and agencies
shared_material.parent_excerpt: in cooperation with the affected executive agencies
shared_material.explanation: Both direct the Bureau to lead a coordinated, interagency undertaking.

shared_material.child_excerpt: undertake the task of reviewing the implications of Hawaii statehood, developing a comprehensive plan for accomplishing the transition, and presenting to me recommendations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: proceed with the development...of plans... I should like to receive from you...a report of your progress together with any recommendations you may have as to further steps required
shared_material.explanation: Parallel administrative sequence: review the problem, develop coordinated plans, and report recommendations to the President.
